language.heading: Interface language
language.description: Applies immediately and is remembered in this browser.
language.note: Only the language preference is stored locally. Stream keys, tokens and metadata are never kept in the browser.

remoteIngest.title: Remote OBS ingest
remoteIngest.description: Publish to this server over an encrypted, authenticated connection from a remote OBS installation.
remoteIngest.rotateConfirmBody: The current credential stops working immediately. You'll need to update OBS with the new one. This is not possible while a stream is actively being received.
remoteIngest.revokeConfirmBody: Remote publishing stops working immediately until you generate a new credential. This is not possible while a stream is actively being received.
remoteIngest.secretWarning: Copy this now - it cannot be shown again. If you lose it, you will need to rotate it.
remoteIngest.secretUsageHint: Enter this as the password when configuring OBS to publish to the RTMPS endpoint above, alongside the streaming-tree-obs username.
remoteIngest.errorStreamingActive: The credential cannot change while a stream is actively being received.
remoteIngest.errorAlreadyProvisioned: A credential is already configured. Use rotate instead.

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.description: Event Bus status and Twitch inbound connectors - a diagnostic and operational view, not the finished operator chat or OBS overlay.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Unified, merged Twitch chat across your connected accounts - the working operator view. For connector diagnostics, see Engagement.
